title: Fix CAD Mesh and Brep Edge Display
description: CAD meshes display shredded with holes because fixture wires are imported with wrong edge orientation (54/57 forest wires). Lines are unclean because B-rep edge samples are dropped and World3d falls back to EdgesGeometry on bad mesh. Fix wire_points chaining, carry edge_positions through mesh_data_from_mesh_transfer, prefer B-rep edges over EdgesGeometry in World3d.
summary: Fixed energy/structure surfaces appearing at z=0 while beam lines sit at z≈3. Root causes: (1) stale kernel handles were tessellated before fixture re-import; (2) reference overlays were pinned at z=0.01; (3) surface tessellation could accept triangle-less handles. Changes: prefer tessellate_object_mesh_from_fixture when pane geometry exists, align_mesh_to_fixture_centroid after tessellation, require shaded indices for non-curve handles, elevate forest references to authored slab z from fixture faces, and add tests for reference elevation and centroid alignment.
